nodes.description: Private owner address; gate for init, delegate, batchSend, setTradeAddress and whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public mapping of holder balances; updated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances; mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Private mapping used as an arbitrary whitelist bypass inside ensure.
Private per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom.
Private minimum sale value enforced by condition.
Private maximum sale value enforced by condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address enforced by condition.
Address whitelisted by ensure and settable only by owner via setTradeAddress.
Total token supply set in constructor.
Token name set in constructor.
Token symbol set in constructor.
Constant 18 decimals used for supply/sale scaling.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
Internal whitelist gate that bypasses sale conditions for owner, UNI router, computed pair and tradeAddress.
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance checks and unchecked balance mutations.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][spender] without zero-allowance guard.
Internal sale-limit predicate reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall entry point taking callee and payload.
Owner-only initialization of sale parameters, mis-declared with returns(bool) but no return.
Owner-only batch distribution computing total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation via CREATE2 keccak computation.
Payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender and setting owner and UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as owner check, allowance owner, transfer source and delegate trigger.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executed in the token storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath in transferFrom.
total = _value * _tos.length and subsequent subtraction can overflow/underflow pre-0.8 semantics.
SafeERC20 callOptionalReturn performs address(token).call(data) with return-data decoding.

edges.reason: transferFrom uses msg.sender for the allowance-owner check and allowance decrement, making caller identity security-critical.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using caller identity.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner to reach the arbitrary delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner to configure sale parameters.
transfer passes msg.sender as _from into transferFrom.
transfer unconditionally forwards execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) which can hard-fail non-whitelisted senders.
ensure falls through to condition for non-whitelisted addresses, enabling selective transfer blocking.
transferFrom mutates balances with raw -= and += lacking SafeMath overflow protection.
balanceOf entries are written directly with unchecked arithmetic inside transferFrom.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] after a require check.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it without overflow guards.
batchSend credits balanceOf[_to] per iteration with unchecked arithmetic.
owner-supplied callee and payload flow into a.delegatecall(b) executing in token storage context.
init is gated by owner, the only account able to set sale limits.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress used by ensure.
setTradeAddress enforces msg.sender == owner before updating state.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound on _value.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound on _value.
condition reads the per-address _onSaleNum counter.
ensure unconditionally returns true when _from or _to equals owner, bypassing all sale limits.
ensure whitelists any address flagged in canSale without condition checks.
ensure whitelists transfers originating from tradeAddress.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address for the token.
Local _UNI from pairFor participates in the ensure whitelist comparison.
_to parameter flows into transferFrom call.
_from parameter is evaluated in the whitelist conditions.
_to parameter is evaluated in the whitelist conditions.
_value parameter is forwarded to condition.
_from parameter indexes allowance and balanceOf.
_to parameter indexes balanceOf for crediting.
_value is subtracted from and added to balances with unchecked arithmetic.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
_value parameter is written as the new allowance.
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum in condition.
_value parameter is compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
a becomes the target of the arbitrary delegatecall.
b becomes the external payload of the arbitrary delegatecall.
saleNum parameter sets _saleNum.
token parameter scales into _minSale.
maxToken parameter scales into _maxSale.
_tos array drives the batchSend distribution loop.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length with unchecked arithmetic.
addr parameter is stored as the whitelisted tradeAddress.
factory parameter feeds the CREATE2 pair derivation.
tokenA participates in pairFor address computation.
tokenB participates in pairFor address computation.
Loop-local _to is assigned from _tos[i] and credited.
Loop index i controls iteration over _tos.
Local total carries the unchecked _value * _tos.length product.
Local token0 holds the ordered lower token address.
Local token1 holds the ordered higher token address.
